title: RAW process-frame nominalization with a written faculty realization role
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. A separate descendant tests qod|aiin as recipient application and qod|ar / qok|ar as one generic faculty nominalization. It adds explicit frame/specification/instance distinctions and a resident-faculty realization obligation; it does not repair the frozen QOD recipient-only contract or merge the old families automatically.

design.mechanism: Two typed application directions over process frames, plus a written realization relation connecting a faculty specification, its acting instance, its bearer and the process host.
design.unit: Future whole E f85r2.7–11 jointly with whole S f85r2.12–17; every occurrence elsewhere in the existing all24-locus projection remains a consistency obligation. No target query or semantic execution performed for this card.
design.contrast: A generic nominalizer retaining the process relation and its host role versus opaque Faculty labels whose instances may be assigned unrelated activities or delegated to a different recipient. A different-organ discourse remains a compatible rival until written references distinguish it.
design.prediction: A written realization of the specification denoted by qodar must use the attraction frame; a written realization of qokar must use the alteration frame. In the explicitly restricted resident-faculty model, the realization's written organ bearer must equal its written process host. Neither faculty possession nor nominalization asserts that an event occurred.

source.edition_limit: Existing public-domain 1916 English edition as reproduced by LacusCurtius, whose page warns it is not proofread. This is not a newly identified medieval exemplar or independent word evidence.
source.complete_argument_summary: III.1 names alterative and attractive faculties by their activities. A part receives suitable nutriment through attraction; presentation is its goal. Adhesion precedes assimilation, which takes time. Continued departure prevents both; a resident retentive faculty is needed, under the stated purposeful-Nature premise. III.9 extends attraction of the appropriate, rejection of the foreign, and powers of retaining and altering all that is attracted to the spleen, liver, veins, arteries, heart and any nourished part; all four faculties are necessary. The proposal must eventually express this entire scope, not merely list four names.
source.not_inherited: III.9's following residue-comparison paragraph and adjacent III.2–8/10–12 are not adopted. Browser display exposed neighbouring text but did not enlarge the selected source units.
source.source_omissions: The source does not identify Voynich roots, application direction, a common physical organ across E/S, a unique faculty token per organ, or cessation exactly at assimilation. Possession is not current activity or sufficient nourishment.

proposed_types.ProcessFrame: A typed record with process relation, named host role, faculty argument and material argument. It denotes a relation, not an event or an assertion that it occurs.
proposed_types.FacultySpec: A faculty specification retaining its originating ProcessFrame. This elaborates the generic faculty names in E; it is not an acting individual.
proposed_types.FacultyInstance: A faculty referent such as S f. A written assertion can associate it with a specification and an organ bearer. No globally unique instance or disjoint physical object for each faculty name is assumed.
proposed_types.Realizes: A relation taking a written event/predication e, faculty instance f, faculty specification s and organ bearer b. It does not itself introduce any of these arguments.

component_assignments.qod: Frame A, whose semantic kernel is A.eval(r)(f,x)=ATTRACT(f,x,r); its host is the recipient/goal r. The kernel agrees with the old qodaiin output, while its packaging as a Frame is new.
component_assignments.qok: Frame L, with L.eval(r)(f,x)=ALTER(f,x,r), alteration of the material with respect to the recipient part. This is a new frame value constrained only by the old qokar faculty meaning; it supplies neither complete assimilation nor a successful nourishment endpoint.
component_assignments.ar: The single generic function NOM:ProcessFrame→FacultySpec. NOM(F) retains F's process relation and named host role. It is never a RecipientRef, an assertion, or the acting faculty f.

application_rules: Forward case: a written Frame immediately followed by a written RecipientRef r yields F.eval(r). In qod|aiin this is the old attraction predicate awaiting f and x; the old separate goal argument must agree with r.

Backward case: a written Frame immediately followed by NOM yields NOM(F). The result's process relation and host role are inherited from that same Frame, not selected by the spelling of the whole word.

The backward rule is identical inside a licensed compound and across a real word boundary. A standalone ar therefore needs an immediately preceding complete written Frame expression; it cannot retrieve an unspoken frame or serve as a noun by itself.

Only the three compound cuts qod|aiin, qod|ar and qok|ar are licensed here. No arbitrary substring deletion, opposite-direction fallback, silent LOC_OWNER conversion or segmentation of every ar-ending word is licensed.

additional_content_law.scope: Only a proposed realization explicitly read as the resident natural faculty of the nourished part in these two Galen arguments. It is not a universal law for all attraction, external agents, instruments, diseases or every possible faculty.
additional_content_law.law: Realizes(e,f,NOM(F),b) requires a written faculty-instance/specification/bearer association for (f,NOM(F),b), requires e to instantiate F's process relation, and requires HOST_F(e)=b. These are constraints on a proposed model, not a change to the denotation ATTRACT(f,x,r).
additional_content_law.no_free_witness: E's necessity statement supplies no named instance f. An existential faculty at an organ does not identify S's oteey. Same kind never entails same physical instance, and an E organ is not automatically S's recipient.
additional_content_law.no_event_creation: NOM(F), possession of NOM(F), or qotom's necessity claim never entails existence of a realized event. Actual realization must be asserted by a separate whole-clause construction.
additional_content_law.no_functional_monopoly: A faculty referent may have several explicitly stated specifications. Realizing NOM(L) cannot be silently replaced by realizing NOM(A); a different declared specification would be an additional assertion, not a rescue by unspecified multifunctionality.

concrete_discriminators: Given explicitly written Realizes(e,f,qodar,b), an event that is only alteration and not attraction cannot discharge that assertion. Given Realizes(e,f,qokar,b), an event that is only attraction cannot discharge it. The nominalizer is reused; distinct relation kernels force distinct content obligations, without counting four labels.

Given a written resident-faculty association at b, a written qodaiin event of the same f with recipient r and an explicit b≠r contradicts this restricted host law. A delegated-faculty model allows it. Without written b, r and the same-f link there is no observed contradiction.
All four faculty specifications may be possessed while no nourishment event occurs. This preserves RAW553's earlier necessity-only consequence; it is not claimed as the new contribution.

serious_rivals.name: Delegated realization
serious_rivals.law: Keep the same frame-derived specifications and actual processes but permit a faculty borne by b to act toward a distinct r. It differs from the restricted resident model only when the written bearer and host are separately bound. It is a coherent general process model, not a malformed arity control.

serious_rivals.name: Different-organ discourse
serious_rivals.law: E speaks of a faculty of one organ or a universally required kind; S describes an event at another organ. This remains compatible with both full source arguments. Neither common work, common kind, repeated spelling nor figure proximity refutes it.

serious_rivals.name: Independent faculty names
serious_rivals.law: Keep RAW553's whole faculty names and the S attraction predicate as independent lexical hypotheses. No common root or ar projection is asserted. An observed complete reading must actually exercise the shared relation or host constraints to distinguish this rival; rerendering the three old glosses is insufficient.

known_countercases_and_limits: qotchd is an already assigned faculty with no ar; qotedar is an already assigned retentive faculty whose qoted base has not been assigned. Both remain atomic under this limited proposal. This is not an exhaustive faculty-noun morphology.

S dar is OF, ytedar is before-adhesion, and oldar is presentation completion. Their ar substrings do not become NOM by deletion of arbitrary remainders. They defeat an unsupported claim that every ar substring is a faculty suffix, not this explicitly limited segmentation.

The old RAW554 report already lists standalone ar at 4 ZL,6 IT,6 RF positions across .1/.20/.22/.24. Every one would retain NOM and owe its preceding written Frame. None has been bound or tested here. A bound-only ar allomorph would be a different costly contract, not an automatic escape.
All outside-S aiin occurrences remain reference-scope obligations. An E aiin is not silently assigned an organ and then identified with S r; a new counted binder and scope rule are needed.
GDT686 competing qod/qo boundaries and i-run readings remain; ain is not aiin. No output or result of the current qod-family test was consulted.
Forward Frame–Recipient and backward Frame–NOM are two grammar cases. A single written order does not prove this type-dependent reversal, and a finite type dispatch can still overfit a small family.
Source naming by activity motivates a nominalization hypothesis but supplies no target morpheme. Old conditional UNTIL cessation and source-goal qualifications in550 are not repaired.
